meta.title: Fix XAML compiled binding warnings in DeviceTests.Runners by adding x:DataType attributes
meta.body_summary: Add x:DataType attributes to three XAML pages in DeviceTests.Runners to eliminate 37 XC0022 warnings and enable compiled bindings for improved runtime performance.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added x:DataType to XAML files to address 37 compilation warnings, but DataType in TestAssemblyPage.xaml was incorrectly set to TestCaseViewModel instead of the actual item type; PR closed without merge despite multiple approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 13 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround performance PR but was closed without merge despite multiple approvals.

review_details.concern_detail: In TestAssemblyPage.xaml, the DataTemplate's x:DataType was set to local:TestCaseViewModel, but the ItemsSource TestCases yields TestCaseViewModel objects, so the DataType should be the same. daltzctr and mattleibow pointed this out via inline comments.
review_details.performance_claim: Enabling compiled bindings by adding x:DataType improves runtime performance by eliminating JIT overhead.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after approvals and CI pipeline run, but no merge. No explicit rejection comment; closure reason unclear.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent correctly identified warnings and added x:DataType attributes, but misidentified the item type for TestCases property, indicating a gap in inferring property types from code. Merge was hindered by incorrect attribute despite small scope.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewers inspected the XAML changes and identified the incorrect x:DataType on TestAssemblyPage.xaml.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance measurement; only claim of improved runtime performance through compiled bindings.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The incorrect DataType was not fixed before closing; PR closed without addressing review feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Added x:DataType attributes to three XAML pages (HomePage.xaml, TestAssemblyPage.xaml, TestResultPage.xaml) to enable compiled bindings and eliminate XC0022 warnings.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding x:DataType attributes with no follow-up fix for incorrect DataType.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out x:DataType in TestAssemblyPage.xaml DataTemplate is incorrect; should be the type of items in TestCases.
Confirmed that TestCases property returns TestCaseViewModel, and the DataTemplate's x:DataType should match.
Approved the PR after initial review comments; no further blocking issues.
Approved the PR with no additional comments.
Triggered Azure Pipelines with /azp run command.
Azure Pipelines successfully started running 3 pipelines.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with x:DataType additions to three XAML files.
Within 30 minutes, daltzctr and mattleibow identified incorrect DataType in TestAssemblyPage.xaml inline.
Despite this, mattleibow and StephaneDelcroix subsequently approved the PR (no change requested).
After 27 days, mattleibow triggered CI pipeline; PR remains open but eventually closed without merge.
